branches.conclusion: Official 2026 bilingual admission regulation Article 6 explicitly defines this distinct institution`s level of education as Undergraduate, and Article 10 specifies bachelor certificates. The current official major menu lists Business Administration at undergraduate level; no institutional doctoral provider scope is available under this official current classification.

Industrial Engineering is a current major, but the official 2026 institution regulation expressly classifies the education level as undergraduate and its certificates as bachelor awards. The German founder`s degree certificate in the dual-degree mode is not a BiUH doctorate. Thus no current BiUH Industrial Engineering doctoral programme can be inferred from this undergraduate major.
